name: callout
title: Callout
description: A note pinned to one mark on a chart: written `@callout{{Month 2 drop-off, tag, c4, row="Feb 2026", col=M2}}`, it draws a marker on the mark it names and the note beside the figure, the two tied by one of six shapes and one color. A chart draws at most six. On by default; an author turns callouts off for the deck with `callout: off` in the front matter, or for one slide with the `callout-off` class (`callout-on` turns them back on), and a host with `--disable-plugin callout`. Off, a callout is not drawn or narrated, and its detail still reaches the speaker note. Split from the legend plugin by engineering/decisions/2026-10-20-callout-placement.md: a `@legend{…}` span that pins a mark, and the `legend: off` and `legend-off` switches, are the pre-split spellings and still work. The heatmap reads callouts today.
